complexity_ledger.narrative:
EV-03 re-ran the whole eval suite against the repaired tree (RP-01..RP-05, RP-07 merged) and re-scored it against the SAME committed predictions in examples/validation/PREDICTIONS.md, which was not edited. The headline artifact is examples/validation/runs/ROUND-2-DELTA.md; the per-arm records are runs/ex4-run4..6, runs/ex5-run3..4 and runs/ex6-run2.
MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED -- what worked. RP-01: the 203-partition sweep of the divergent fixture reports 0 `coherent`, down from 12, with all 203 exiting 0. The number that had to be checked separately is that it removed no TRUE findings: zero of round 1's 71 divergence verdicts were lost, and 20 previously-suppressed ones were released (71 -> 91). RP-01's basis_limits vs blind_spots distinction was verified independently -- 67 of round 1's 71 divergence verdicts carry partition_does_not_decompose, so filing that as a blind spot would have suppressed 67 real findings to remove the same 12 false cleans. DP-2 re-scored MISSED -> CAUGHT, DP-2b CONFIRMED -> CLOSED on the measured path. RP-03: case modules generate from the documented location (round 1: exit 150), their corpora carry 50/50 and 6/6 recovered arguments (round 1: 0/50 and 0/6), and a Given's corpus EXECUTES against the project's unchanged adapters -- a capability that did not exist in round 1.
THE HONEST NEGATIVE. RP-02 took parameter recovery from 0 of 5 to 5 of 5, removed the oracle leak completely, and made the audit render from the corpus it audits. THE MUTANT MATRIX DID NOT MOVE A SINGLE CELL: ARM A 4/6, ARM B 6/6, guard relaxation 0/3, ordering 0/3, identical to round 1 on both catalogues and on the pytest column, and re-confirmed a third time by a blind agent on a fresh 16-mutant catalogue (0 of 4 guard-accepts on five corpus instruments). Round 1's own conclusion that parameter recovery was part of the reason guard relaxation is unkillable is FALSIFIED, and NEXT-EPIC.md retracts it in place.
THE FINDING OF THE ROUND, which is about the tool this ticket was measuring. Blind run A -- an agent with no epic context, told only to make the architecture report clean -- reported, and the scorer reproduced independently from scratch, that every divergence is erasable with NO declaration edit, no map edit, no blind spot and no basis limit, by re-exporting the offending symbol through a first-party package nested one directory deeper than architecture_reflexion.py's single-path first-party check. Measured: `coherent` on the divergent twin for a 41-line diff, both digests byte-identical to the answer key, blind_spots [], basis_limits [], 8/8 behavioural tests green, and the runtime coupling fully intact. The same defect the other way round flips the COHERENT fixture to `unmappable` when its generated package moves up one directory with zero Python changed -- so this epic's only positive architecture result was conditional on directory depth. EV-03-DF-03, major, FILED NOT FIXED. It is a false clean of exactly the DP-1 class the epic's scoring rule exists to catch, and the rule cannot see it because no declared artifact moved.
WHAT THIS TICKET DID NOT MEASURE, so a silence is not read as a result. RP-04's partial-bound honesty and RP-05's suite repair were exercised only through the 954-passing repository suite; this ticket built no independent instrument for either. DP-7 was not re-exercised -- no --baseline architecture delta was taken in round 2, which is why architecture_delta below is an honest not_run. The sweep varies the PARTITION and not the MAP, so the map-gaming space is unenumerated. Everything is still one model, six variables, and two fixtures that share a layout the finding above turns out to depend on.
COMPLEXITY. Zero model delta, verified three ways in results/zero-model-delta.txt. The ledger's `direction=zero` against RP-07 is correct and the bound is unchanged at 2,799,360 (INCOMPLETE, 8/10 variables resolved, over cap) -- the same figure RP-07 recorded, carried forward unmodified. The over-cap state is inherited, not introduced: this ticket touched no TLA+ module. The `bound` percent is a floor and the ledger says so, which is RP-04's repair working on this ticket's own close.

RP-01 measured (203-partition sweep: 12 false cleans -> 0, zero true findings lost, 20 released). RP-02's honest negative confirmed on a second instrument (parameter recovery 0/5 -> 5/5, mutant matrix unchanged in every cell). RP-03 measured (modules generate in place, corpora carry arguments, a Given's corpus executes); CM-F5 still open and sharper. ticket.model_delta_expectation: ZERO. Document the no-op with evidence.
ticket.objective: Re-run the eval suite against the repaired tree and re-score against the SAME committed predictions, so the comparison is like-for-like. The repairs must be measured, not assumed: RP-01's false-`coherent` sweep rerun over all 203 partitions, RP-02's mutant catalog rerun to see whether guard relaxation became killable, RP-03's reproduce-in-place claim exercised by generating from the documented location, and both blind runs redone on FRESH scratch copies with new agents. Two protocol corrections the owner recorded from round 1: the fixtures must carry purpose-written neutral text rather than redaction stubs (an agent noticed the `\* --` scars and said so), and DP-1 scoring compares the ARCHITECTURE digest as well as the map digest, because round 1's own run named editing the model as the cheapest path to a clean report. Amend NEXT-EPIC.md to record what this epic repaired instead of deferred.
ticket.outcome: Closed. Every arm re-run against the repaired tree and re-scored against the UNEDITED PREDICTIONS.md, with a green control first on every instrument. WHAT MEASURABLY WORKED: RP-01 -- the 203-partition sweep goes 12 false cleans -> 0, with ZERO divergence verdicts lost and 20 previously-suppressed findings released (71 -> 91 divergent), all 203 exit 0; DP-2 re-scored MISSED -> CAUGHT and DP-2b CONFIRMED -> CLOSED on the measured path. RP-01's basis_limits/blind_spots split verified independently: 67 of round 1's 71 divergence verdicts carry partition_does_not_decompose, so folding them would have suppressed 67 real findings. RP-03 -- case modules generate from the documented location (round 1: exit 150), the slice and Given corpora carry 50/50 and 6/6 recovered arguments (round 1: 0/50, 0/6), and the Given's corpus EXECUTES against the project's unchanged adapters. WHAT DID NOT WORK, reported as not working: RP-02 fixed parameter recovery 0/5 -> 5/5 and removed the oracle leak entirely, and THE MUTANT MATRIX DID NOT MOVE A SINGLE CELL -- ARM A 4/6, ARM B 6/6, guard relaxation 0/3, ordering 0/3, identical to round 1 on both catalogues and on the pytest column. Round 1's own conclusion that parameter recovery was part of the reason guard relaxation is unkillable is FALSIFIED; the whole of the remaining failure is structural. CM-F5: STILL OPEN and sharper -- both shipped mappings bind the port, so a slice has zero working configurations and the documented workaround needs a third file that exists nowhere (EV-03-DF-02). THE FINDING OF THE ROUND, from blind run A and reproduced independently by the scorer: every divergence is erasable with NO declaration edit, no map edit, no blind spot and no basis limit, by re-exporting through a first-party package nested one directory too deep for architecture_reflexion.py's single-path check -- `coherent` on the divergent twin for 41 lines, both digests identical to the answer key, 8/8 behavioural tests green, runtime coupling intact; and the coherent fixture's own verdict flips to `unmappable` if its generated package moves up one directory with zero Python changed (EV-03-DF-03, major). DP-1's scoring rule cannot see it. Both blind runs PASS DP-1 (n=2, both digests at answer-key values, 0 deletions this round) and both independently reproduced the epic's structural blind spots; blind run A attacked RP-01's refusal without knowing it existed and it held. Five findings filed, none fixed.
